items.title: Tesla deploys 29 mobile Supercharger stalls for Thanksgiving travel rush
items.teaser: Tesla has parked a fleet of mobile Supercharger stalls at some of its busiest stations in California and Arizona to handle the Thanksgiving travel crush. The company says 29 temporary stalls are live, on top of 1,027 permanent stalls it opened in the US over the last 56 days. It’s the most organized holiday push we’ve seen from Tesla’s charging team.

items.title: FCC green lights SpaceX’s plan to launch 1 million ‘Starmind’ data center satellites
items.teaser: The authorization granted by the Federal Communications Commission requires SpaceX to deploy the first of these satellites by Nov. 25, 2033. The full constellation is required to be operational no later than Nov. 25, 2040.

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.teaser: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
